## Summary

Describe the change and its user impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test:run`

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No credentials, secrets, personal data, or private configuration were added.
- [ ] Existing routes, accessibility, and English/Spanish behavior were preserved.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog were updated when needed.
